remarks: Sophisticated townhouse-style living offering 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and rare designated backyard green space - perfect for an outdoor patio set and barbecue. Step into a contemporary open-concept living and dining area featuring gleaming hardwood floors, high ceilings, recessed lighting, and custom wood blinds. The home has been freshly painted throughout and enhanced with new vanities, fixtures, and designer lighting. The gourmet kitchen is beautifully appointed with white shaker cabinetry, granite countertops, and new stainless steel appliances. The second level features a spacious primary bedroom with walk-in closet, along with two additional generously sized bedrooms and a full bath. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer, efficient gas heating, and central air conditioning. Ideally located just steps from vibrant downtown Stamford's premier dining, shopping, and nightlife.
